title: Sale of Victoria Barracks Sydney 'mind-boggling', says retired colonel
paragraphs: A retired colonel says plans to sell "the ancestral home" of the Australian Army is "mind-boggling", joining a chorus of prominent voices criticising the federal government's decision.
Victoria Barracks in Sydney's east has been an active Australian Army base for over a century.
But a recent independent audit found Defence's estate portfolio was too difficult to maintain, with underused and ageing facilities placing an increasing burden on resources.
